pitch: UB Zombie Tokens. Eleven nontoken Zombie cards of 24 nonland slots feed Necroduality's 'Whenever a nontoken Zombie you control enters, create a token that's a copy of that creature', while Gisa's Bidding x2, Deluge of the Dead, and Ghoulish Procession x2 add 2/2 Zombie tokens directly. Bladestitched Skaab x2 turns that width into damage at 'Other Zombies you control get +1/+0'. Because the ground stalls against a cube with 20.9% evasion density, the deck goes over the top rather than through: Skirsdag High Priest converts spare bodies into a 5/5 flying Demon every turn, Haunted Dead brings a flying Spirit, and Stitched Mangler x2 taps the blocker out of two consecutive combats. Village Rites x2 is the sacrifice outlet that makes Ghoulish Procession self-supplied and the deck's only unconditional card draw.

pitch_es: Fichas de Zombi UB. Once cartas de Zombi no-ficha de 24 huecos no-tierra alimentan el 'Whenever a nontoken Zombie you control enters, create a token that's a copy of that creature' de Necroduality, mientras Gisa's Bidding x2, Deluge of the Dead y Ghoulish Procession x2 añaden fichas de Zombi 2/2 directamente. Bladestitched Skaab x2 convierte esa anchura en daño con 'Other Zombies you control get +1/+0'. Como el suelo se atasca frente a un cubo con un 20,9% de densidad de evasión, el mazo pasa por encima en lugar de por medio: Skirsdag High Priest convierte cuerpos sobrantes en un Demonio 5/5 volador cada turno, Haunted Dead trae un Espíritu volador, y Stitched Mangler x2 gira al bloqueador durante dos combates consecutivos. Village Rites x2 es el medio de sacrificio que hace a Ghoulish Procession autosuficiente y el único robo incondicional del mazo.
